state_machine.description: Parameterized state covering all 32 command vectors. At each scan, c is read from the pre-scan pumpGroup[].RunComd values; there is no independent retained command shadow.

transitions.next: For each i, command[i] := sampled pumpGroup[i].selection.
Command exactly the three pumps with highest sampled priority. For each i, rank is 1 plus the number of pumps with greater priority, or equal priority and lower index; command[i] := rank <= 3.
Preserve the pre-scan command vector, regardless of mode or configuration changes.

priorities: Stop overrides start and clears every command in the same scan.
Start is level-sensitive: every scan with start TRUE and stop FALSE reselects from the current sampled configuration.
Manual selection is ignored in automatic mode; equal automatic priorities favor the lower array index.
Write only RunComd. Never modify priority or selection.
Commands do not establish actual pump availability or physical safety; the interface provides no feedback or interlocks.

initial_values.pumpGroup[1..5].RunComd: FALSE, initialized by the caller before the first operational scan.
initial_values.internal_retained_command_state: None; pre-scan RunComd values are authoritative.
initial_values.temporary_values: Assigned from the current scan snapshot before use.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
scan_execution_order.action: Sample mode, start, stop, all priorities, selections and pre-scan RunComd values once. No edge detector is required; start and stop are level-sensitive.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.action: Compute a complete next-command vector using stop first, then manual or automatic start, otherwise the sampled pre-scan commands. Rank priorities without negating INT values.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.action: No timer FBs are required; this stage is a no-op.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.action: Write the computed vector to pumpGroup[1..5].RunComd in one unified assignment section. Do not write other fields.

formal_assertions.formula: G((!stop & start & !mode) -> ((pumpGroup[1].RunComd = pumpGroup[1].selection) & (pumpGroup[2].RunComd = pumpGroup[2].selection) & (pumpGroup[3].RunComd = pumpGroup[3].selection) & (pumpGroup[4].RunComd = pumpGroup[4].selection) & (pumpGroup[5].RunComd = pumpGroup[5].selection)))
